confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Alicante and Spanish coastal city prices, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and in July is the least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are benchmarked to beer and general Spanish bar pricing rather than direct Alicante observations. The FX observation was taken from search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not verified against the F11 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Spanish Mediterranean coastal cities with similar summer tourist demand, such as Valencia, Málaga and Murcia, adjusted for Alicante's beach-resort seasonality in July.
